summary.intent: Enhance the summary TUI detail pane to display all available session data from the insights SQLite DB, including scores, token breakdowns, files touched, tool usage, and all facet types with evidence.
summary.outcome: Design was fully brainstormed, a spec was written and committed, an implementation plan with 6 tasks was written, and subagent execution began with Task 1 (formatDuration helper) completed and Task 2 (renderSummaryBox rewrite) dispatched.

repo: The insights.db has 16 tables; facets are extracted per-session via LLM calls and stored in tables like friction, learnings, failure_loops, repeated_user_instructions, missing_context_signals, skill_signals, review_rule_signals, codebase_patterns, implementation_rationale, tradeoffs.

Facet backfilling means: sessions initially cached with has_facets=0; on improve/insights/memory-loop runs, transcripts are condensed and sent to LLM for extraction, then has_facets=1 is set to avoid re-extraction.
The summary TUI detail pane is in cmd/entire/cli/summarytui/detail_page.go; SessionRow struct already contains all the data fields (scores, token breakdown, facets) but most were not being rendered.
Facet evidence fields exist on each facet type (e.g. Evidence, SourceKind, Strength, WhyReusable on review rules; Friction and MissingInstruction on skill signals).
The Codex companion script hits ENOBUFS on large repos when trying to run adversarial reviews — the git diff buffer overflows.

code.finding: Current detail pane renders: SESSION, TOKENS, SUMMARY, FRICTION, LEARNINGS, INSIGHTS boxes — all facets lumped into one INSIGHTS box, missing scores, token breakdown, files touched, tool usage, rationale, tradeoffs, patterns, and per-facet evidence.

Facets structs contain evidence fields used for backfilling and rendering; key types include ReviewRuleSignal (Evidence, SourceKind, Strength, WhyReusable), SkillSignal (Friction, MissingInstruction), FailureLoop, RepeatedUserInstruction, MissingContextSignal.

workflow: Brainstorming skill generates visual HTML mockups served on localhost:65000 for layout design decisions.
Subagent-driven development dispatches one subagent per plan task, with review between tasks.
Specs are written to docs/superpowers/specs/ and plans to docs/superpowers/plans/ before implementation begins.

friction: Codex adversarial review failed with ENOBUFS — the repo's git diff is too large for the companion script's internal buffer; both foreground and background runs failed.
The brainstorming skill's visual companion required a separate server start and browser open, adding setup friction for layout decisions.
open_items: Tasks 2–6 of the implementation plan are not yet complete: renderSummaryBox rewrite (in progress), CODE box, SIGNALS box, wiring/test updates, and final lint/test pass.
Codex adversarial review was skipped due to ENOBUFS; the spec was not externally challenged.
The spec clarification around SUMMARY box omission logic (when HasSummary=false but scores/stats are zero) was patched in the spec but not yet verified in the implementation.
